sources.finding: MIT license, 1,059 stars on 2026-11-16, last push 2026-05-25, not archived, 52 open issues and pull requests.

sources.title: takopi v0.23.4 release
sources.finding: Release v0.23.4 published 2026-05-25; also published to PyPI as takopi 0.23.4.

sources.title: takopi on PyPI
sources.finding: Package takopi 0.23.4 with documentation, homepage, issues and repository links to takopi.dev and GitHub.

sources.title: takopi readme
sources.locator: features, requirements, install, setup, usage, plugins
sources.finding: Telegram bridge for codex, claude code, opencode and pi with projects, git worktrees, stateless resume, progress streaming, parallel runs with per-session queue, voice notes, file transfer, topics and existing subscriptions; requires uv, Python 3.14 and an engine on PATH.

sources.title: MIT License
sources.finding: MIT license text.

sources.title: pyproject.toml
sources.finding: Python package with anyio, httpx, openai, pydantic, typer, watchfiles; MIT classifier; OS Independent; Python 3.14.

sources.title: changelog
sources.finding: Releases through v0.23.4 (2026-05-25): Codex app-server default, steer and cancel buttons, reasoning overrides, retry of Telegram network errors.

sources.title: Configuration reference
sources.finding: Config at ~/.takopi/takopi.toml: bot token, chat id, allowed_user_ids, session_mode, voice, topics, files, projects with worktrees_dir and worktree_base, plugins.

sources.title: Commands and directives
sources.locator: Message directives, Telegram in-chat commands, CLI
sources.finding: Directives /engine, /project and @branch, in-chat commands /cancel /agent /model /reasoning /trigger /file /topic /ctx /new, and CLI commands init, chat-id, doctor, plugins.

sources.title: Worktrees how-to
sources.finding: @branch runs a task in a dedicated git worktree under worktrees_dir; ctx footer carries context forward.

sources.title: Worktree implementation
sources.finding: Runs git worktree add (with -b for a new branch) under the project worktrees directory and refuses a non-worktree path.

sources.title: Takopi specification
sources.finding: Resume tokens and lines, normalized events, per-thread serialization, scheduling, progress and cancellation, lockfile for a single instance.

sources.title: Telegram transport
sources.locator: Incoming messages, Trigger mode, Chat sessions, Forum topics, Outbox, Rate limiting
sources.finding: Voice transcription, mentions-only trigger mode, chat sessions stored in telegram_chat_sessions_state.json, forum topics, outbox with rate limiting and backoff.

sources.title: Topics
sources.finding: Forum topics bind a repo and branch with their own session and default engine for team chats.

sources.title: File transfer
sources.finding: Optional /file put and /file get with upload and download size limits and a deny glob list.

sources.title: Voice notes
sources.finding: Optional voice transcription through an OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoint.

sources.title: Schedule tasks
sources.finding: Relies on Telegram native scheduled messages (including daily and weekly recurrence); takopi has no scheduler of its own.

sources.title: Codex runner
sources.finding: Runs codex app-server by default and answers approval requests with accept, permission requests with the requested scope and MCP elicitation with decline.

sources.title: Claude runner
sources.finding: Runs claude -p non-interactively; permissions must be preconfigured or dangerously_skip_permissions set; no interactive question handling.

sources.title: Plugin API
sources.finding: Entry-point plugins for engines, transports and commands.

sources.title: Environment variables
sources.finding: Only logging, non-interactive and Pi directory variables; no telemetry settings.

sources.title: CI workflow
sources.finding: CI runs ruff format and lint checks, ty type checking, pytest, uv build and a docs build, and notifies on commits.

sources.title: takopi Claude runner usage payload
sources.locator: _usage_payload; pi.py MessageEnd/AgentEnd usage; search of src/takopi for usage and cost
sources.finding: The Claude runner copies total_cost_usd, duration, num_turns and usage from the result event into the completed event, and the Pi runner keeps the last message usage. A bounded search of src/takopi/*.py, telegram/ and presenter/markdown rendering found nowhere that displays, stores or exports it.
